I plant cassava and sweet potato on this plot, with some local beans intercropped between the rows as I have always done. I have kept cassava cuttings from last season's harvest, so I do not need to spend money on new seed. I will spread cow manure from our family animals before the rains come, but chemical fertilizer is too expensive for root crops when the government voucher mainly helps maize farmers. We will work this plot ourselves with hand hoes since the Lake Zone rains are enough and I have no money to hire labor or buy sprayers.
